574-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.
574-4419-4694-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

539-3821-4679-6023-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-6023-6495.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat

2023-3755-4770-4927.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3698-6972-7782.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Clockwork Hydra enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

4871-5147-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5147-5220-7806.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

282-1479-5233.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Boros Garrison onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Boros Garrison trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

292-1495-7704.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-7704.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

3197-5789-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-5789-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

856-3899-4321-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3899-4321-7396.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

95-7268.description: Cast Kitsune's Technique by paying its mana cost, causing an opponent to mill their library due to Bruvac.
95-7268.notes: If able, you can instead cast Kitsune's Technique using its sneak cost.

2173-3944-5220-6094.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

5465-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender by paying its mana cost.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender.
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat from step 2.

1399-1606-3664-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

3007-3525-6788.easyPrerequisites:
You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
You have at least one card in hand.
3007-3525-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3007-3525-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1274-4186-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6752.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
1247-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

252-4871-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3708-4613-4968.description:
Activate Wall of Limbs by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Wall of Limbs triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-1231-4826-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-3817-5256-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-5256-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1479-5621-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5621-6529.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3542-4477-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
3542-4477-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Greenwarden of Murasa and Palinchron, targeting Greenwarden of Murasa
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Greenwarden of Murasa and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

3490-4210-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4210-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple indestructible.
3490-4210-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life. If you gained life this way, Amalia will trigger.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life. If you gained life this way, Amalia will trigger.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

277-1479-3678-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-3678-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

225-730-880.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
225-730-880.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1244-4231-4518-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
1244-4231-4518-5542.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Cast the other creature by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Repeat.

3389-4050-4365-5043.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {3}{G}{U}, targeting a permanent.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Doppelgang, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5352.notes: If you have an additional {3} available, you may use it while casting Doppelgang to create tokens of additional permanents.

1651-2097-4259-4659.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2724-2963-4006.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Teleportation Circle. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1315-3781-3946.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional land.
Your life total is at least three.
1315-3781-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, causing you to put an age counter on it and lose 2 life.
Play any land from your graveyard.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Glacial Chasm, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, doing nothing.
Repeat.

222-969-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Slimefoot and Squee does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
222-969-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slimefoot and Squee as attackers.
Slimefoot and Squee triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

703-969-2751-2972.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Resolve the copy of Astral Dragon's ability, creating two token copies of Strionic Resonator that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Strionic Resonator tokens enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Strionic Resonator copy by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 6.

193-703-2719.notablePrerequisites: Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters on it.
193-703-2719.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Astral Dragon.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of Aminatou that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Aminatou tokens, you may instead activate their first ability for infinite draw triggers.
